title: Service Contracts: amendment count, named accounts and rate revisions by tier
content:
## Scope
This reference covers four per-tier amendment figures of the Aurelia Hanse Line (AHL) Service Contracts product: how many amendments may be filed per contract term, how many affiliated companies may be named to book under the contract, whether the base rates may be revised by amendment during the term, and how many rate revisions a term may take.

## Parameters by tier
| Tier | Filed amendments per term | Named accounts (affiliated companies), at most | Mid-term rate revision allowed | Rate revisions per term |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Starter Service Contract | 4 | 0 | no | 0 |
| AHL Standard Service Contract | 4 | 2 | no | 0 |
| AHL Regional Account Contract | 6 | 5 | no | 0 |
| AHL Key Account Contract | 8 | 10 | yes | 2 |
| AHL Global Account Contract | 12 | 25 | yes | 3 |
| AHL Strategic Partner Contract | 12 | 50 | yes | 4 |

## Quick questions
**Can an affiliated company be named to book under an AHL Starter Service Contract?** No. The tier's figure for named accounts is 0.

**Can the base rates of an AHL Regional Account Contract be revised during its term?** No. Mid-term rate revision is open only in the Key Account, Global Account and Strategic Partner tiers.

**How many rate revisions may an AHL Global Account Contract take in one term?** 3.

**How many amendments of all kinds may an AHL Key Account Contract file in one term?** 8.
